question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The dog was __agitated__ and bit the child.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"agitated"** means feeling or appearing troubled or nervous. (चिंतित या व्याकुल)

 
 
• **Example: **The speaker was visibly **agitated** during the heated debate.
 
 
 
• **"Serene"** refers to being calm, peaceful, and untroubled. (शांत)
 
 
• **Example: **The **serene** landscape helped her relax and forget her worries.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'agitated' **is **'serene'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Steady **(स्थिर): Firmly fixed, supported, or balanced; not shaking or moving.

 
 
• **Example:** He kept a **steady** hand while drawing the intricate design.
 
 
 
• **Quiescent **(शांत): In a state or period of inactivity or dormancy.
 
 
• **Example: **The volcano has been** quiescent** for years.
 
 
 
• **Nerveless** (निर्भीक): Lacking in nervousness or anxiety; calm.
 
 
• **Example:** The** nerveless** player took the game-winning shot with ease.
